metadata.artifact_title: DeepSeek Harness ADR-05: Iterator and Failure Architecture
metadata.source_title: A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability
metadata.artifact_scope: BD-ITER iterator, continuation, folding, boundedness, reach, and failure carrier

ADR-02.provenance_note: The local accepted revision is authoritative for this chain; this ADR does not mutate the earlier ADR-02 item.

decision.statement: Use a ranked continuation machine with an external control-code type Q. Each run returns halt, yield with a state-dependent successor, or raise with an error; every yielded successor has strictly smaller Nat rank. Execute by well-founded recursion and retain the accumulated prefix inverse on failure.
decision.paper_fidelity_status: formalization-repair/refinement-profile; the paper's literal mu-recursive equation remains a source notation rather than the Lean core
decision.control_code_boundary: Q is external program/control data and is not RawState, FiberName, IncarnationId, or a recursive FiberCell field
decision.termination_certificate: run q gamma = yield delta undo next implies rank next < rank q
decision.finite_profile: path finiteness is guaranteed by rank; all-node enumeration additionally requires an explicit finite closed support or Fintype Q specialization
decision.failure_policy: raise yields no new state or inverse; ExecResult.failure retains error, boundary state, and inverse for the successful prefix
decision.error_observation: exact equality by default; a coarser diagnostic relation must be supplied explicitly
decision.async_policy: asynchrony and divert/landing are control-layer trace constraints, not iterator constructors

constructors.name: yield
constructors.meaning: successful stage followed by a state-dependent continuation code of lower rank

constructors.name: raise
constructors.meaning: failure at the current boundary; no successful-stage witness is produced

failure_result.prefix_undo_rule: A failed continuation propagates the inverse accumulated by all preceding successful stages.

equations.raise: execFrom q gamma = failure error gamma id
equations.halt: execFrom q gamma = success delta undo
equations.yield_success: run q gamma = yield delta undo next and execFrom next delta = success final inner => success final (undo composed with inner)
equations.yield_failure: run q gamma = yield delta undo next and execFrom next delta = failure error final inner => failure error final (undo composed with inner)

execution.composition: composeUndo outer inner = outer o inner; application is outer(inner(x))
execution.lifo: The continuation inverse is applied first, then the current-stage inverse; this is D52's LIFO order.
execution.plain_effect_embedding: A one-node rank-zero machine that always halts embeds an ordinary witnessed effect.

boundedness.count_definition: stageCountFrom counts the current stage and recursively counts yielded continuations
boundedness.uniform_predicate: UniformlyBounded it K := forall q gamma, reachableFromRoot it q -> stageCountFrom it q gamma <= K
boundedness.root_certificate: Every ranked iterator is uniformly bounded by stageLengthBound it root = rank(root) + 1
boundedness.convention_note: The paper's len(i) prose is ambiguous between continuation edges and stages; the blueprint records the convention at each T66 instantiation.

reach_and_generators.has_next: hasNext it q q' iff there exist gamma, delta, undo with run q gamma = yield delta undo q'
reach_and_generators.reach: Reach is the reflexive-transitive closure of hasNext and quantifies over all possible input states, not only one concrete run
reach_and_generators.rank_monotonicity: Reach it q q' implies rank(q') <= rank(q)
reach_and_generators.failure_safe_generators: D60 generators are first represented as successful stage graph edges; failures have no total forward projection
reach_and_generators.graph_closure: TransformClosure contains identity, generator edges, and transitive composition
reach_and_generators.function_monoid_refinement: For total deterministic nonfailing stages, the graph can later be reified as a submonoid of Function.End Gamma
reach_and_generators.independence: Iterator independence remains an explicit relation-level certificate requiring map commutation modulo the selected observation, inverse stability, and continuation stability

relations.pointwise_inverse: PointwiseRel R f g := forall related x,y, R (f x) (g y)
relations.stage_relation: halt compares with halt, yield with yield and related continuation codes, raise with raise; success and failure never cross-relate
relations.same_code_specialization: StageRel uses equality of Q for local StepLawful contracts
relations.bisimulation_interface: IteratorBisim accepts a separate continuation relation C and is the replacement for the paper's greatest iterator relation
relations.witness: InverseProper R gamma delta undo := R (undo delta) gamma; the witness is imposed only on halt/yield

integration.adr03: Iterator code, rank, runner, and interpreter environment stay outside RawState/FiberCell; no unrestricted RawState -> RawState field is introduced
integration.adr04: IncarnationId is a name-bearing lifecycle identity, distinct from Q. Any nested allocation must be exposed by later labelled control steps
integration.alpha_equivariance: Name-neutral iterator payloads require an explicit opacity assumption; name-capturing payloads need a rename action and interpreter equivariance
integration.control: BD-CONTROL consumes ExecResult and supplies L-Begin, L-Iter, L-Finish, L-Raise, L-Divert, retry policy, and labelled orchestration
integration.staging: Committed-view/guarded-unload staging is supplied by BD-STAGING and is not smuggled into the iterator carrier

paper_mapping.formal_boundary: RankedIterator, StageResult, rank-decrease certificate, StageWitness, StageRelC, IteratorBisim

alternatives.reason: Does not choose least/greatest/productive semantics and supplies no executable termination certificate.
Useful for potentially infinite behavior but incompatible with the current finite T66 profile without an additional boundedness layer.
Easy to execute but loses state-dependent continuation selection unless a separate compilation theorem is added.
Fuel can truncate a valid iterator and therefore should not be the semantic invariant.
Preserves dynamic branching, supports well-founded execution, exposes a finite bound, and avoids recursive State closures.
More general than Nat rank, but the current theorem target needs an executable uniform finite bound.

alternatives.alternative: failure as Option or identity inverse
alternatives.reason: Erases error, boundary state, or prefix recovery and breaks L-Raise reasoning.

acceptance_gates.description: No literal mixed-variance/fixed-point type in executable core
Executable one-step and recursive fold semantics
Failure carries error, boundary state, and prefix undo
ADR-03/ADR-04 state and identity boundaries preserved
Pinned Lean compile with no placeholders

revision_policy: Editorial clarification retaining ranked carrier: patch revision.
Additional executable lemmas retaining carrier: minor revision.
Changing to an unbounded/coinductive default, identity failure projection, or RawState-stored iterator: superseding ADR required.
Frozen Harness-03/04 and accepted ADR-01/02/03/04 artifacts remain unchanged.
